name: Kemenespálfa (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and yellow at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kemenespálfa: a blue shield with yellow ears of grain, a plough and a sword.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
